description: This PHP class defines a model for managing subscription status records in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for CRUD operations, managing descriptions, and caching for subscription status entities within the admin panel.

classes.name: SubscriptionStatus
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription status records, including add, edit, delete, retrieve, and description management functions within an OpenCart system.

methods.name: addSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Creates a new subscription status record in the database, inserting entries per language and associating descriptions.

methods.name: editSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Replaces existing subscription status data with new data, including associated descriptions, and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Deletes a subscription status record from the database and clears related cache.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all subscription status entries associated with a specific language ID and clears cache.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription status record by its ID for the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of subscription statuses with optional filtering, ordering, and pagination, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription status records, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description record for a specific subscription status and language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all subscription status descriptions for a given language ID.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific subscription status description for a particular status ID and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given subscription status ID, indexed by language.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all subscription status descriptions associated with a specific language ID.
